findings.detail: Pale balcony edges, dark glazing, inset jambs and real slab relief are visible on closer towers on both layouts; compared with the prior broad flat grids this is a material improvement. Original unrefined sides and repeated generic profiles remain visible.
Tour11/12 and driver stills show open two-storey steel bays, thin roofs and visible background through the structures. The original opaque blue nominal shells are absent from those enhanced views.
Asphalt no longer shows the large cloudy mottling of the prior baseline. Red-white kerbs read as continuous low profiles. The now quieter road is nearly flat at medium and distant scale.
The source-deck/fence spacing is still visibly much broader than the measured driving-width paint. The upcoming corridor replacement must be reviewed separately; these captures do not certify it.
Thin fence mesh, distant steel members, palm fronds and some facade lines still show visible stair-stepping or speckling. Still images do not establish whether they shimmer in motion.

Phone03/10 show long soft twin trails from the drift, with the car still legible. Source particle generation, lifetimes and physics remain, with reduced road-camera presentation size and opacity; the source driving photos do not support a claim of normal tyre smoke.

An initial visual concern about northern phone framing was resolved by independently projecting the real source route and both contours through the captured phone camera eye, target, FOV and aspect. Zero vertices fall outside either viewport axis; cropped upper streets are surrounding city context.

limits: Static daylight Balanced screenshots only; not a real-phone timing, full-motion, night-mode, context-recovery or dynamic aliasing assessment.
No new black frames, gross geometry tears, missing car bodies or invalid text were observed in these 30 stills.
Clean browser checks and reference-informed details do not establish a 10/10 visual rating, photorealism, surveyed architecture or surveyed event-barrier placement.
The private source photos and screenshot pixels remain outside the repository; this file contains only provenance hashes and review observations.
